title: Boundary scenario desired-move-in-date-too-far-future now submits a VALID date — expected validation_error can never fire
evidence: Scenario at this sha: line 17 `expected_outcome: validation_error`, lines 18-19 `expected_error_fields:\n  - desired_move_in_date`, line 24 `  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE}"`. The scenario's own description still says: `Yearly maintenance: when 2030 falls within +12 months of today, bump \`desired_move_in_date\` further out so this scenario keeps exercising the upper-bound branch.` The SKILL.md added in the same commit says: `{MOVE_IN_DATE}` is `today + 90 days` and `Only the boundary-validation scenarios (\`desired-move-in-date-in-past\`, \`-too-far-future\`) pin literal dates on purpose.` Server (application_handler.gleam, validate_move_in_date): `order.Gt -> Error("Pick a date within the next year.")` against `move_in_limit(today)` = `let target_year = today.year + 1`.
detail: The AC requires scenario content to correctly exercise the form at this sha. {MOVE_IN_DATE} = today+90d is within the server's 12-month limit, so no desired_move_in_date error fires; a fully valid submission returns confirmation and the scenario fails every run. The over-broad date sweep replaced the pinned 2030-01-01 the upper-bound branch needs, contradicting the SKILL.md line added in the same commit.
recommended_fix: Restore a literal far-future date (e.g. 2030-01-01) in this scenario's desired_move_in_date, keeping {MOVE_IN_DATE} everywhere else.

title: bug-hunt landing happy-path (apply-form.yaml) submits without mandatory reference_contact_choice — confirmation page never renders
detail: The rework edited this file (added ?stepper=off) to keep the E2E suite exercising the form at this sha, but missed the RC1.1 mandatory-field injection its sibling skill documents as required for every scenario. Submit bounces to the validation-error re-render; the 15s wait for confirmation-page times out. Critical-priority scenario fails every run.
recommended_fix: Add a javascript step before submit injecting a hidden input name=reference_contact_choice value=attested into the form (mirroring form-bug-hunt flow step 12), until the RC1.2 radio ships.

title: listing-source-tamper expects field-listing_source-error span that F4 removed — assertion path no longer exists
evidence: Scenario: `expected_error_fields:\n  - listing_source`. SKILL.md flow (line 206): `validation_error` → `[data-testid="error-summary"]` visible AND each `expected_error_fields:` entry has its `field-{name}-error` span populated``. Grep of server/src/application/form_sections shows listing_source survives only as `pub const listing_source_options` and a comment in work_income.gleam — no field-listing_source markup or error span is rendered. Sister scenario has-pets-missing-answer.yaml documents the banner-only pattern: `# ...no inline \`#field-has_pets-error\` span exists in the markup. The load-bearing assertion is the \`validation_error\` outcome plus the banner entry` with `expected_error_fields: []`.
detail: The tamper_hidden_inputs rework converted the injection but left expected_error_fields pointing at an inline span the F4 field diet deleted. The server rejection is real but only observable in the error-summary banner, so the flow's mechanical per-field span check cannot pass as written.
recommended_fix: Set expected_error_fields: [] on listing-source-tamper.yaml and note the banner-only assertion (the has-pets-missing-answer pattern), or extend the flow to allow banner-row assertions for unrendered fields.

title: apply-form-structure still asserts 'All 7 sections' — guarantor section absent from checks at an 8-section sha
evidence: Line 2: `description: "Public SSR application form renders with all 7 sections, consent checkbox, and submit button"`; line 64: `expected_outcome: "All 7 form sections, consent checkbox, and submit button render correctly"`. The form renders 8 section fieldsets; guarantor.gleam:91 `attribute("data-testid", "section-guarantor")` is never checked by the scenario.
detail: The rework touched this file (stepper=off) under a stale-content-refresh mandate but left the 7-section description and checks; the structure smoke never verifies the guarantor section renders. Still passes, so coverage gap only.
recommended_fix: Add the section-guarantor element_count check and update description/expected_outcome to 8 sections.
